hero.titleLead: Everything you need to measure stress.
hero.body: Stress Index is the most complete professional HRV software on the European market. Here is what you can do with it.

scores.description: You do not need to be an HRV expert to use Stress Index. The 5 proprietary scores give you an instant snapshot of your client: how stressed they are, how they recover, whether the nervous system is in balance, how much energy they have and how well they adapt to load.

items.name: Stress Index
items.description: How much pressure the nervous system is under. Based on 5 weighted parameters: Baevsky Stress Index, SDNN, Total Power, DFA Alpha1, HF norm.

items.name: Recovery
items.description: The parasympathetic system’s capacity to regenerate. If it stays low over time, the client is not recovering between sessions.

items.name: Balance
items.description: The sympathetic-parasympathetic balance. Higher is not better here. The optimal value sits in the middle.

items.name: Energy
items.description: The nervous system’s overall energy resources. Based on the total power of the spectrum.

items.name: Adaptation
items.description: The autonomic nervous system’s capacity to recover and adapt to everyday demands. Unique on the market.

params.titleEm: The whole literature, always with you.
params.description: For the professional who wants to go deeper, Stress Index computes every parameter validated by the scientific literature.
params.calloutBody: Every parameter gets a color-coded traffic light based on reference ranges for the client’s age and sex (Nunan 2010, Voss 2015). No need to memorize reference values, the app does it for you.

tests.titleEm: From the standard protocol to the long session.
tests.description: Four measurement modes designed to cover 100% of situations in the practice and in the field.

items.title: Standard Measurement
items.body: A snapshot of the current state. 5 or 10 minutes, seated or lying down. You will run 70% of your assessments with this one.

items.title: Orthostatic Test
items.body: Measures the reactivity of the nervous system. 5 minutes lying down, then 5 minutes standing. The app guides the transition with sound and vibration. Perfect for slow recoverers, persistent fatigue and overtrained athletes.

items.title: Coherence Breathing
items.body: Animated visual guide for breathing. Find your client’s personal resonance rate. Real-time coherence score. Ideal when you work on relaxation, sleep quality and tension management.

items.title: Long Sessions
items.body: Open-ended duration to measure during your sessions. Real-time tags, analysis every 2 minutes, automatic before/after comparison. Show your clients that the session works, with data.

tests.athletesNote: Do you work with athletes? There is a dedicated module with real-time DFA Alpha1 and live metabolic zones.

pdf.body: A 4-page PDF you can print, email or show the client during the session. It includes every score, the detailed parameters, the HRV charts (Poincaré, rhythmogram, PSD spectrum) and the legal disclaimer. Customizable with your name, title and practice.
items: Custom header with your name, title and practice
5 proprietary scores with a color bar chart
25+ HRV parameters with reference ranges and traffic light
HRV charts: Poincaré, RR rhythmogram, PSD spectrum
pdf.mockFooter: Page 1 of 4 · Generated by Stress Index

crm.description: Manage all your clients in one place. Full profile, measurement history, session comparison, professional notes. Everything synced between the app and the web dashboard.
items: Compare up to 29 parameters across sessions

dashboard.body: Access your clients’ data from your computer at stressindex.io. Interactive charts, trends over time, automatic alerts, periodic PDF reports. Perfect when you are at the desk in your practice.
items: Interactive charts with dual Y axis
Automatic alerts on stress and recovery
Periodic PDF reports with automatic commentary
Full CRM accessible from the browser

privacy.description: Your clients’ sensitive data is protected by the strictest European regulation. No hidden tracking, no third parties, no surprises.

items.title: Encryption
items.body: Data encrypted in transit and at rest.

sensors.titleEm: Or with the one we recommend.
sensors.description: No proprietary hardware. Stress Index connects over Bluetooth to the main heart rate sensors on the market.
sensors.calloutBody: We recommend the Polar H10: ECG, millisecond precision. It is the one we use internally for every test and validation. For step-by-step setup, see the <link>sensor guides</link>.

h10.name: Polar H10
h10.note: Our standard, ECG, maximum precision. Recommended.

h9.name: Polar H9
h9.note: Same ECG quality as the H10, excellent value for money.

oh1.name: Polar OH1 / Verity Sense
oh1.note: Optical arm sensor, works but less precise than an ECG strap.

tickr.name: Wahoo TICKR
tickr.note: Works, good BLE stability. Test it with your own unit.

coospo.name: CooSpo H808S
coospo.note: Works, inexpensive ({price}), lower quality than Polar.

whoop.name: Whoop 4.0
whoop.note: Transmits BPM only, not the RR intervals needed for HRV analysis.

garmin.name: Garmin straps (HRM-Dual, HRM-Pro)
garmin.note: Do not transmit RR intervals over standard BLE.

watch.name: Apple Watch
watch.note: Does not transmit ECG data over BLE.

cta.body: Every feature. No commitment. Cancel anytime.
